scope_rationale: Finite84 event-driven-parsing requires nested incremental events and separate consumer, beyond binary framing or ordinary expression trees.

competencies.outcome: Derive a bounded incremental scanner and exact consumed-prefix/error locations across names, five fixed entities, partial tokens and overwritten consumed input.
Implement nested start/text/end events, matching names, bounded depth and empty tags; retain exactly one unaccepted event through backpressure and reject reentry.
Compose a copied two-event queue with an independent decimal-leaf consumer; prove segmentation invariance, checked accumulation and complete-document publication authority.
Falsify four distinct defects, compare independent Expat events under changed chunks/schedules, and audit actual resource/helper costs without overclaiming XML conformance or mastery.
